//: Copy to flow-recorder.config.json (or run `npx playwright-flow-recorder init` to generate one from your repo layout). Every key is optional — delete what you don't need.
//maskPattern: Typed values are recorded as ***masked*** when the field's type, name, id or placeholder matches this. type=password is always masked regardless. `auth(?!or)` keeps an 'author' field readable.
//maskAllInput: OPTIONAL. Mask EVERY typed value, not just fields that look sensitive. The only defence when the field is called `j_idt42` (legacy JSF/ASP.NET, obfuscated builds) and no pattern can tell what it holds. Conversion quality drops — the agent must resolve every literal from fixtures — which is the trade regulated teams want.
//redactUrlParams: URL parameters whose VALUE is replaced with *** in the per-event url stamp, in nav events and in net query strings. Matched per name component, so access_token / id_token / X-Auth-Token / apiKey are caught while zipcode and monkey are not. Covers the fragment too, where implicit-grant flows put the token. Parameter names survive so the agent still sees the request shape.
//onCreate: OPTIONAL. Command run when you click ⚡, so the hand-off reaches an agent instead of waiting for one to read the queue file. Empty (the default) spawns nothing. A string runs through the shell; an array is spawned directly with no shell. Context arrives as env vars — FLOW_QUEUE_FILE, FLOW_SESSION_FILE, FLOW_ACK_FILE, FLOW_PROJECT_ROOT, FLOW_QUEUE_DEPTH, FLOW_ENQUEUED, FLOW_SCENARIOS — so nothing needs quoting into the command. One runs at a time: clicking ⚡ again while it works does not start a second agent. Disable for one run with `record --no-hooks`.
